The lesson here isn’t, “Oh, we got it wrong about them!”

Nor is it, “Oh, we seriously got it wrong!”

Nor is it, “They misrepresented the real reasons for the conflicts in Palestine.”

Nor is it, “They lied to us about Palestine.”

Nor is it, “They lied to us big time!”

Nor is it even, “They deliberately, with determination, mindfucked us into believing exactly the opposite of the truth!”

Nor yet, “If they lied to us about that, they’re lying to us about everything!”

No.

The real lesson is that you had no fucking clue.

And, unless you want them to keep mindfucking you over, again and again, you’d better figure out how to fucking get a fucking clue.
